scope: Read-only posterior summaries, block-quantile precision and the three previously declared probe omissions from a freshly qualified, explicitly typed native accuracy2 target. No model, background, spectrum, sampling or cache mutation.
prerequisite: native_accuracy_qualify.qualify_run must freshly reconstruct all2000 records, unchanged original chains/slots/proposal densities, numerical target/configuration, fixed32 screen/refinement/persistent-worker pilot and every original importance gate. A preparation descriptor or status string is insufficient.
quantities: Sampled coordinates remain the original points. All derived quantities, exact component densities and raw weights come from accuracy2. Preserve explicit duplicate selected slots. Never rename old accuracy1 outputs or call an old qualifier on new records.
omissions: Use exactly sn, bao and lensing removals from probe-omission-design.json, with every prior and auxiliary dimension retained. Reuse its pure statistical summarizer only through a documented arithmetic view containing native2 quantities. It does not instantiate a model or qualify the source cohort.
gates: Original luminosity-sensitivity-design.json overlap gates unchanged, including all sampled nuisance coordinates and native2 derived diagnostics. A failed removal retains diagnostics and withholds posterior/sign/covariance. Removing a probe cannot establish probe consistency or globally adequate proposal support.
quantiles: Unchanged quantile_precision.block_quantile_precision:500 replicates for both10 and20 contiguous blocks per chain, original seeds, original midpoint weighted-CDF interpolation and explicit repeated slots. This is a precision diagnostic, not a new acceptance gate.
identity: Hash the actual native2 configuration after the precise allowed removal, parent numerical target identity, removed component names and the current consumer/kernel/design source hashes. Parent proposal identity remains separately recorded. All complete parent file bindings are checked before and after the read-only calculation.
reporting: Conditional posterior means/SD and68/95 intervals. Sign fractions are finite Monte Carlo summaries, not frequentist significance or guaranteed exclusion bounds. Fixed LambdaCDM jerk and fixed brightness are model assumptions. No age correction is identified here.
implementation_status: Implemented and synthetically validated with known Gaussian targets, chronology/corruption controls and the actual typed production boundary. The public validation receipt must bind the frozen current producer, qualifier and kernel sources before execution. No observational result exists until a real accuracy2 parent freshly qualifies; user authorization for the overall measurement is already given.
